description: Search 463 London sights, museums, parks, markets, hidden gems and day trips from the London Tourist Map, with opening hours checked on official websites, current ticket prices and the nearest Tube station (with step-free access). Use for questions like "free things to do in London", "rainy day ideas", "hidden gems near Covent Garden", "step-free museums" or "what's open on Sunday". Returns up to 15 places, each with a link to it on the map.

day_trips.description: Include day trips out of London (default false).

free.description: Only places that are free to enter.

near.description: A place, station or area to search around (e.g. "British Museum", "King's Cross").

open_on.description: Only places open on this day: a weekday ("Sunday") or a date (YYYY-MM-DD).

query.description: What to look for, in plain words: a type of place, a theme or a name (e.g. "museums", "Harry Potter", "markets", "views").

step_free.description: Only places with a step-free entrance.

vibe.description: A theme: hidden_gems (Hidden gems), editors_picks (Editor's picks), only_here (Only in {city}), nature (Nature escapes), thrills (Thrills), quirky (Quirky & bizarre), romantic (Romantic), family (With kids), rainy_day (Rainy day), after_dark (After dark).

name: find_london_places
title: Find London places
